moments.title: Complaint arriving
moments.description: The customer opens the case; complaint text is being received.

moments.title: Attachments ingested
moments.description: The three supporting attachments are recorded on the case.

moments.title: Officer acknowledges the customer
moments.description: The Agentic Case Officer confirms receipt and promises daily updates.

moments.title: Officer dispatches Complaint Agent
moments.description: The Officer assigns the Customer Complaint Agent to open the investigation.

moments.title: Complaint Agent analyses text
moments.description: The Complaint Agent classifies urgency and extracts the incident summary.

moments.title: Complaint Agent inspects attachments
moments.description: Image and document understanding is applied to the three attachments.

moments.title: Complaint Analysis Package prepared
moments.description: Complaint Analysis Package is completed and ready for handoff.

moments.title: Result returns to the Officer
moments.description: The Officer receives the Complaint Analysis Package.

moments.title: Officer dispatches Policy Agent
moments.description: The Officer assigns the Policy Agent to check applicable policy.

moments.title: Policy Agent retrieves policy
moments.description: The Post-Handover Defect Resolution Policy is retrieved from the repository.

moments.title: Policy Agent validates coverage
moments.description: Warranty coverage and contractor responsibility are validated against the policy.

moments.title: Policy Evidence Package prepared
moments.description: Policy Evidence Package is completed and ready for handoff.

moments.title: Result returns to the Officer
moments.description: The Officer receives the Policy Evidence Package.

moments.title: Officer dispatches Workflow Agent
moments.description: The Officer assigns the Workflow Agent to prepare the enterprise operational workflow.

moments.title: Workflow step 1 — Maintenance Work Order
moments.description: Step 1 of 4 submitted: Maintenance Work Order.

moments.title: Workflow step 2 — Site Inspection Request
moments.description: Step 2 of 4 submitted: Site Inspection Request.

moments.title: Workflow step 3 — Vendor Assignment
moments.description: Step 3 of 4 submitted: Vendor Assignment.

moments.title: Workflow step 4 — Customer Update Schedule
moments.description: Step 4 of 4 submitted: Customer Update Schedule. Enterprise Workflow Package completed.

moments.title: Result returns to the Officer
moments.description: The Officer receives the Enterprise Workflow Package.

moments.title: Officer dispatches Finance Agent
moments.description: The Officer assigns the Finance Agent to complete the financial recommendation.

moments.title: Finance Agent reviews costs
moments.description: Repair estimate reviewed against handover records.

moments.title: Finance Agent validates compensation
moments.description: Compensation basis validated; budget availability confirmed.

moments.title: Financial Recommendation Package prepared
moments.description: Financial Recommendation Package is completed and ready for handoff.

moments.title: Result returns to the Officer
moments.description: The Officer receives the Financial Recommendation Package.

moments.title: Approval package presented
moments.description: The Officer presents the resolution package for human approval.

moments.title: Case closed
